name: Bridgehollow warden-ring civic hall (winter)
description: Warden's Ring civic buildings (hall, court, records, treasury, barracks, customs, lockup): dressed grey stone with pale quoins and storey bands, steep hipped slate roof with dormers, leaded windows in stone surrounds, round-arched doorway, two stone chimneys. Winter: snow on the roof and dormer roofs.
